DME IPU Admission 2026 – Complete Guide

About DME – Delhi Metropolitan Education, Noida

Delhi Metropolitan Education (DME) is a well-regarded multi-discipline college affiliated to Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU), located in Sector 62, Noida. Run by the Sunshine Education & Development Society, DME has established itself as a strong player in management, law, and media education within the IPU ecosystem.

With 780 total seats across BBA, integrated law, journalism, and LLM programmes, DME offers a focused academic experience. The BBA programme alone has 300 seats across two shifts, while the law division offers both BA-LLB (180 seats) and BBA-LLB (120 seats) integrated programmes. The BA(JMC) programme adds a media dimension with 120 seats, and three LLM specialisations cater to postgraduate law aspirants.

DME is particularly known for its well-structured curriculum, industry-oriented teaching approach, and active placement cell. The Noida Sector 62 location provides excellent connectivity and access to corporate offices. For personalised admission guidance at DME, call 9899991342 today.

DME Admission Process 2026

Admission to DME is conducted through the centralised GGSIPU counselling process based on respective entrance exam scores:

  1. BBA: IPU CET (BBA) score + IPU counselling registration
  2. BA-LLB/BBA-LLB: CLAT or IPU CET (Law) score + counselling
  3. BA(JMC): IPU CET score + counselling registration
  4. LLM: IPU CET (LLM) or equivalent + counselling
  5. Fill DME programmes as preferences during choice filling
  6. Accept allotted seat and report to campus with documents

Management quota seats may be available for select programmes. Call 9899991342 for complete DME admission support.

Placements at DME

DME has a strong placement record among IPU-affiliated colleges. Key highlights:

  • Average Package: 4-7 LPA
  • Top Recruiters: Deloitte, EY, KPMG, ICICI, HDFC, Aaj Tak, NDTV
  • Placement Rate: 70-80%
  • Highest Package: Up to 10 LPA (BBA/Law programmes)

Campus Life at DME

  • Modern classrooms with smart boards
  • Moot court hall and legal aid clinic
  • Media lab with recording studio
  • Central library with legal databases
  • Sports facilities and cultural festivals

DME is a top choice for students targeting admission under IPU. For personalised admission guidance, call 9899991342 today.
